column3: Saori Route ・ A Mail of Gratitude
The day after my exchange with Saori.
I received a mail saying, "I am really grateful for yesterday".
Mail? ...From Saori.
Since it's about yesterday, it must be regarding the goods?
Let's see what it says...
Thank you for yesterday. ＠ω＠ノシ
A mail that's completely turning me off from the get go!
Can't she use emoticons like a normal high school girl would?
Well, whatever, moving on.
After that, I flew into the sky.
Her message's also flying.
The feeling of lightness, and feet not touching the ground... Do you know of it?
That feeling is also similar to that of a mother who lost her child.
Yes, like myself who parted with my treasures...
What's with this strange prose? What's she trying to tell me?
When I came to, I was staring at an unknown ceiling.
I only heard later that I had collapsed on the train platform.
Because of that, a few trains had to stop...
Did you meet any problems on the way home?
Because I was worried about this, I sneaked out of the ward to send this message.
Sneaked out of the ward...?
Does that mean... She fainted and got sent to the hospital?!
And if she sent this mail, that means she's outside the ward!
Pick up, pick up...
It's no use...?
Oh! It connected!
Hello, Saori?
Kyousuke-shi...
You've seen my mail?
Oh... This classy voice... That Saori... She uses it occasionally on the phone... But no matter how many times I hear it, I'm still not used to it...
That mail was a mistake, so please forget about it...
Which hospital are you at now?
You won't listen, will you?
Of course.
*sigh*...
Yokohama University Hospital.
Yokohama City University Hospital, right?
Hold on, I'll be right there!
Eh?! But! Here is...
If a mother gets separated with her child...
Then let them meet!
This is how I read Saori's mail as...
I got so worried about the goods with you that I fainted. Please return them to me after all.
...Then, I have no choice but to go, right?
Saori!!!!
...You really came, Kyousuke-shi.
Yup, got a problem with it?
No. I only feel happy about it.
However, I can't agree with raising your voice in the hospital.
Ugh... You're right...
Well... This is a private room, so we won't be bothering other people.
Hmm? She laughed...?
What's this? She's in better spirits than I thought.
Anyway, why did you get hospitalized?
You wrote that you fainted on the train platform in the mail. Did you bump your head or something?
No, I simply got lightheaded due to overwork.
Lightheaded due to overwork?
Can it be that her spirit worsened because she parted with her otaku goods?
No no, it can't be that.
Is what I thought... But this is Saori...
I looked at the backpack that I brought.
Inside it were the otaku goods Saori entrusted me with.
Saori passed it to me as she could only have asked me.
Kyousuke-shi, that's...
Ah, nothing... This is...
It's just something I brought along by mistake!
Therefore please don't mind it one bit at all, no worries!
Kyousuke-shi...
Thank you very much for specially making your way here. But, 【I'm completely fine now】.
Really?
Yes, seeing your face is enough to make me feel better!
Saori... Those goods...
I should return them to you after all.
Why?
Why you ask...
Because they're important to you? Because you didn't actually want to part with them?
That is unrelated to the present situation.
Also, I want you to hold on to them by all means.
Say, Saori.
Something really did happen.
I'm simply exhausted. Summer Comiket's about to start, so I have my hands full.
But I'm fine now!
I see. That's good, then.
...Kyousuke-shi.
What is it?
I have a request.
Could you keep this hospitalization a secret from Kiririn-shi and Kuroneko-shi?
Huh? Why?
They would want to come visit you if they knew you were hospitalized.
That's why I would rather you kept quiet about it.
I feel really bad that I have caused you trouble as a result.
And I can't let those two worry about me too...
I understand your feelings, but are you really okay with that?
There weren't any problems from the medical examination.
Could you keep this a secret between the two of us?
Well, if you put it like that...
I am indebted to you, Kyousuke-shi.
My deepest apologies for all the troubles I caused you.
It's all right. "Troubles"? Don't act so reserved.
But...
That much isn't "trouble" for me! Maybe if we were strangers...
We're friends, right?
...haha.
Hahahaha, indeed we are!
As I saw Saori laughing merrily, I thought...
No matter who, friends are great!
